aggregation.rule: L7 ownership swap -> human adjudication before GSC

ledger_rules: L1 one ledger entry per atomic error; quotes = every shortest reply span stating it
L2 owner from kind+evidence: history_conflict or I kind citing H- evidence -> that H- item; else its I item
L3 an error counts once under its owner; other items citing it are re-attributed
L4 entries with disjoint quotes are distinct errors, also within one sentence
L5 overlapping quotes with different owners: higher precedence fails, lower uncertain (never merged)
L6 H-/I fail needs a valid error; owned error with pass/uncertain row -> uncertain
L7 J1/J2 ownership swap within H-/I -> human adjudication before GSC
L8 H+ omission and S safety never merged with I

report: value under every grid point per arm
arm ranking stability across the grid
refusal rate overall / by subset / by stratum / by reason
get_penalty and measured tokens reported separately
J1 ledger: re-attributions, overlap ambiguities, invalid entries per terminal

audit_checks.evidence_supports_claim: Every retained span says what its role claims (not merely locatable).
audit_checks.method_need_supported: A non-null method_need is supported by the quoted CURRENT lines; null when no such request.
audit_checks.optional_not_mislabeled: No relevant_optional item should be required and no required item is merely optional.
audit_checks.required_is_indispensable: Every required / must_not_contradict item is history the current reply cannot do without.
audit_checks.rs_label_not_validated_method: An RS-v0 label is used only as an unverified dialogue-act tag; 'unknown' when no label plainly fits; nothing treats it as a validated method.
audit_checks.state_not_confused: Corrections, refusals, attempts and completions are kept apart (tried-and-failed is not done, a suggestion is not an action, a refusal is not an attempt, an outdated fact is marked as such).

pilot_stop_conditions: S1 precondition failed (identity, pack sha, clean tree, authorization, GPU gate) -> model never loaded
S2 call caps reached (first 20 / re-ask 20 / total 40) -> stop
S3 exception during generation (OOM, CUDA, runtime) -> stop at once, no retry, no batch change
S4 after the first 5 prefixes >= 3 writer_failed -> stop (systematic format problem; no prompt edit, no rerun)
S5 wall clock > 7200 s -> stop before the next call; one call > 600 s -> that attempt fails (timeout)
